roles.definition: A charted reading in a panel. ONE role for all fourteen charts: the five intent words (comparison · change-over-time · distribution · relationship · composition) already live on th

intents.definition: Correlation or connection BETWEEN two or more quantitative measures — 'does this move with that?'. Both axes carry measures; the point cloud, not the axis order
